issues.title: [Reproduction] Build and run the Podman image on Linux
issues.body: CI validates the `lab/Containerfile` recipe; reports from real machines are what counts. Run `cd lab && bash scripts/run-podman.sh --auto` on Linux and open a reproduction report with versions and full output, also if it fails.

issues.title: [i18n] Review the English translation of Part I · Before translating
issues.body: Compare `book/es/parte-1-antes-de-traducir/` (original) with `book/en/part-1-before-translating/`. Look for technical fidelity, terminology consistent with the glossary (Annex F) and the author's voice: first person, short sentences, bold maxims. One PR per chapter is perfect; `python3 scripts/check.py` must stay green.

issues.title: [Lab] Compile the COMP-3 codec of chapter 15 and promote it to Verified
issues.body: Turn the COMP-3 codec listing into a small .NET 10 project inside `lab/` with tests for the seven vectors in the table of chapter 15, including the two that must fail. If it passes, change the listing label to *Verified* in both languages.

issues.title: [Lab] Compile the Strangler facade (ch. 14) and the Orleans grain (ch. 19)
issues.body: Both listings are *Illustrative*. A minimal project that compiles and a test that demonstrates the described behaviour would promote them to *Verified* in both languages.
